article.summary_es: Make the Road New York aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos en Jackson Heights, Queens. Abre los miércoles de 8am a 10am.
article.summary_en: Make the Road New York is listed on the Food Help NYC map as a food pantry in Jackson Heights, Queens. It is open Wednesdays 8am-10am.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está ubicada en 92-10 Roosevelt Ave, Jackson Heights, NY, 11372.
Abre los miércoles de 8am a 10am para la despensa.
Puede llamar al (718) 565-8500 para preguntar antes de ir.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni si hay requisitos.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry according to the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 92-10 Roosevelt Ave, Jackson Heights, NY, 11372.
It is open Wednesdays 8am-10am for the pantry.
You can call (718) 565-8500 to ask questions before going.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are requirements.
